# LP Web Studio

## Description
LP Web Studio is a Cape Town-based web development agency specializing in custom React websites, performance optimization, and technical SEO for small businesses. We guarantee 90+ Google PageSpeed scores and instant lead generation through WhatsApp integration.

## Services
- Custom Website Development: High-performance React/Next.js sites built on modern architecture
- Technical SEO: Schema implementation, Core Web Vitals optimization, and semantic HTML
- Website Audits: Performance, accessibility, and conversion reviews
- WhatsApp Integration: Instant lead capture through direct messaging

## Pricing
- The Starter Template: R2,500 once-off + R350/pm (1-page professional website)
- The Professional: R4,500 once-off + R350/pm (3-page custom design, 90+ PageSpeed)
- The High-Performance Build: From R7,500 (5+ pages, fully custom Next.js & Tailwind CSS)

## Technology Stack
- Next.js (React framework for blazing-fast performance)
- Tailwind CSS (utility-first CSS for rapid, consistent design)
- Framer Motion (smooth, engaging animations)
- Vercel Hosting (global CDN, optimized for Next.js)
